headline: Public hearing on Harvey Gamage National Register nomination and workshop on new construction at 101 & 105 Winter Street.
summary: The board will hold a public hearing on recommending the Harvey Gamage vessel for National Register nomination, and will hold a workshop reviewing new construction plans for 101 & 105 Winter Street. The board will also report on attendance and decisions from the September 16, 2026 meeting regarding an addition at 100 North Street.
items: Report of attendance at the September 16, 2026 meeting on the addition at 100 North Street (Plan Number: HP-00116-2026)
Report of decision: Board voted 6 in favor to approve the addition at 100 North Street
Public hearing: Review of and recommendation to Maine Historic Preservation Commission regarding National Register Nomination for Harvey Gamage, docked at 100 W. Commercial Street
Workshop: Review of new construction at 101 & 105 Winter Street, applicants 105 Winter, LLC. & HSM Development (Plan Number: HP-00123-2026)
location: Room 24 (Ground Level of City Hall) and Zoom
